sloka: प्रायात् अग्रे महातेजा गंग तम् च अपि अनुव्रजत् ।गगनात् शंकर शिरः ततो धरणिम् आगता ॥१-४३-१५॥
transliteration: prāyāt agre mahātejā gaṁga tam ca api anuvrajat ।gaganāt śaṁkara śiraḥ tato dharaṇim āgatā ॥1-43-15॥

translations.english: From the sky on to the head of Shankara and thence Ganga resorted to the earth. There it flowed forward with a roaring sound.
